title: ONSure Decision-Time Knowledge Snapshot v1
description: docs/master/semantic-assurance/158_LEARNING_VALIDATION_P0_CONTRADICTION_POLICY_BINDINGS.md classes 7 (Adaptive Learning vs Reproducibility) and 11 (Ground-truth Drift vs Historical Immutability), bound per contracts/learning-validation-p0-contradiction-contract-bindings.candidate.v1.json LC-P0-007/LC-P0-011. Every learning decision binds to the knowledge_epoch active when it was made; that binding and decision_sha256 never change once recorded (158 SS11: '과거 decision snapshot은 수정하지 않는다'). When current_knowledge_epoch has moved past knowledge_epoch, currentness_state is forced away from CURRENT and a real reevaluation_ref is required -- the decision itself is never edited to look current, and replay with today's knowledge is never claimed identical to the original decision (158 SS7).
$comment: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 without $data cannot declaratively compare knowledge_epoch against current_knowledge_epoch (the real drift check). That comparison, and the resulting currentness_state, is computed by the Java runtime layer (SemanticAssuranceV2WorkflowService.learningDecisionCurrentnessEvaluate) rather than faked here as a schema constraint -- this schema enforces the CONSEQUENCE invariants (CURRENT implies replay-allowed and no reevaluation; STALE/REVIEW_REQUIRED implies replay-blocked and a real reevaluation_ref), not the epoch comparison itself.
